summary: SEC-001 (server-side JWT admin auth) verified. 33/33 pytest cases pass on the public preview URL, plus full frontend Backstage flow (wrong-pw error, correct-pw JWT stored in sessionStorage, STATS loads via Bearer, COUNTRIES block/unblock persists via server, logout clears token). Password remains 'candice2026' (change_password roundtrip test restored it). Brute-force lockout verified as the LAST test in pytest; login_attempts collection was cleared with mongosh afterwards so subsequent logins work.

verification_details.LOGIN: POST /api/admin/login {password:'candice2026'} -> 200 with valid JWT (3-part, expires_in=43200). Wrong pw -> 401. Missing field -> 422.
verification_details.JWT_PROTECTION: For each of GET /api/bookings, GET /api/visits/stats, POST /api/blocked-countries, POST /api/media/upload/init: no Authorization -> 401; old-scheme 'X-Admin-Pass: candice2026' -> 401 (old scheme removed); garbage 'Bearer garbage.token.here' -> 401; valid Bearer -> 200 with correct payload.
verification_details.CHANGE_PASSWORD: Without Bearer -> 401. With Bearer + wrong current -> 401. Roundtrip test (candice2026 -> temp -> candice2026) succeeded; final state confirmed by re-login with 'candice2026' returning 200.
verification_details.BOOKING_RATE_LIMIT: 6 rapid POST /api/bookings from same IP -> 429 observed within the 6 attempts. Created test bookings cleaned up via DELETE /api/bookings/{id} with Bearer.
verification_details.NO_SECRET_IN_CLIENT: GET /admin.js contains neither 'candice2026' nor 'X-Admin-Pass'. GET /backend/.env returns HTML fallback, no MONGO_URL/JWT_SECRET/candice2026.
verification_details.BRUTE_FORCE_LOCKOUT: 5 wrong logins from same IP -> 6th attempt with correct password returned 429 as expected. login_attempts DB cleared afterwards (mongosh db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})).
verification_details.FRONTEND_FLOW: Ctrl+Shift+K opens #adminLogin. Wrong pw -> #adminErr='Wrong password.', #adminPanel stays closed. 'candice2026'+Enter -> sessionStorage 'candice_admin_token' set (JWT, 147 chars, 3 parts), #adminPanel opens. STATS tab -> #statsErr hidden, stat numbers rendered (today=53, week=53, all=53, uses Bearer). COUNTRIES tab: click AF -> GET /api/blocked-countries shows ['AF'] (persisted server-side); click AF again -> [] (unblocked). SETTINGS -> Log out clears sessionStorage token.

critical_code_review_comments: Booking rate limiter uses in-memory _rl_buckets dict — resets on process restart and does not span multiple backend workers. Fine for single-process gunicorn/uvicorn, but note if scaling out. Consider Mongo-backed limiter like login_attempts for consistency.
_rl_buckets grows unbounded (one deque per key+IP forever). Low-severity memory leak on long uptime; consider periodic pruning of empty deques.
Startup uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); switch to FastAPI lifespan context for forward-compat.
get_admin_hash() is called on every login and every password change — cheap, but could be cached in-process; not critical.

Login lockout is per-IP only; behind ingress the _client_ip() correctly reads X-Forwarded-For first entry, but no upstream trust boundary check. If ingress ever forwards client-controlled XFF, an attacker could rotate the header to bypass the 5/15min limit. Consider trusting only the last hop or configuring the proxy to overwrite XFF.
test_credentials: Admin password: candice2026 (restored). JWT stored in sessionStorage as 'candice_admin_token'.
seed_data_creation: During tests: transient booking rows with name prefix 'TEST_rl_' / 'TEST_public_' — all deleted afterward via DELETE /api/bookings/{id} with Bearer token. login_attempts collection cleared post-run via mongosh.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SEC-001 fully verified. Regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_sec001_auth.py (33 tests). NOTE: the brute-force test class TestZzzBruteForceLockout locks the executing IP for 15 min; the file cleans up login_attempts is NOT automatic — if you re-run and cannot log in, run: mongosh mongodb://localhost:27017/candice_database --eval 'db.login_attempts.deleteMany({})'. The booking rate-limit test relies on in-memory bucket which resets only on backend restart; if re-run within an hour without restart it may 429 immediately (test handles this by only asserting a 429 occurs within 6 attempts).
